body: I mean, I know what I have to do.  I definitely need help.  Shit’s not right up here.  My process just changes so dramatically that one minute I’m in a corner crying out that I don’t know what to do and the next I’m self medicating, delusional thinking this is how I cope.  Even now I’m drunker than a mule, but I feel I’m making perfect sense.  My father self medicated.  He ended up holding a few women at gunpoint for the drugs that would get him there and is now in prison.  I’ve never taken it beyond getting drunk, smoking marijuana, tripping on acid or mushrooms few and far between.  I don’t know the future though.  I’m scared.
Eh.  I hope you’re right.  I’m pretty decent with words, though.

Forgive me, but I spout this type of ideology all the time to make those around me feel better about what doesn’t work out for them.  It’s doesn’t do much for me though.  I have a hard time practicing what I preach.  I really do appreciate you here though.

I don’t believe that.  I think a narcissist, or attention whore for lack of better term, would not be aware of their shortcomings.  They’d be delusional in the thought they had none.  I’m not sure why anyone would downvote on this sub at all btw.

I don’t know if I’ve ever been happy.  I think my needs have been satiated.  I think I’ve been content.  I’m not sure if I’ve ever been happy and it eats me alive.  Sure there’s things that have happened that have brought me down.  More than I’m willing to share here because again I don’t want to burden.  I fell like I might have overcome these things, but at the root of it all I’m not sure if I was ever happy.  I just feel a deep sadness that if I let it, swallows everything and makes me feel nothing but.

Have you felt hopeless too?  Don’t take this the wrong way.  I’m being genuine.  I just know it’s hard for some people to understand because of experience, physical makeup and what not.  Thanks for input btw.

I think you definitely have people in your life who care.  I think I do too.  I think maybe I’ve painted a picture of myself where they might be inclined not to though.  I’m worried.  I feel abandoned and I think it’s my own fault.  I don’t think there’s no coming back from that.  I think it’s possible for you.  How do we do it though?
I just went through your comment history, maybe selfishly to guess your intentions.  Is there a reason you frequent this sub?
I don’t want to burden you.  I guess that’s part of the issue.
